q1.explanationZh: civilisation 是英式拼写，civilization 是美式拼写，两种都对；由 civilise 加 -ation 构成。

q2.explanationZh: civilise（英式）/ civilize（美式）“使文明；使开化”，两种拼写都对。

q3.explanationZh: claim 既是动词“声称；认领；提出要求”，也是名词“要求；索赔”。

q4.explanationZh: clap“拍（手）；鼓掌”，过去式 clapped 要双写 p。

q5.explanationZh: clarify“澄清；阐明”，和 clear“清楚的”同源。

q6.explanationZh: class 名词“班级；课；等级”，动词“把……归类”。

q7.explanationZh: classic 名词“经典作品”，形容词“第一流的，经典的”。

q8.explanationZh: classical“古典的”，classical music“古典音乐”；注意与 classic 区分。

q9.explanationZh: classify“把……分类”，由 class 加 -ify 构成。

q10.explanationZh: class“班级”+ mate“伙伴”= classmate“同班同学”。

q13.explanationZh: clean 动词“把……弄干净”，形容词“干净的”。

q14.explanationZh: clean 加 -er 表示人或工具：cleaner“清洁工；吸尘器”。

q15.explanationZh: clear 可作动词“清除”、形容词“清楚的；晴朗的”、副词“完全”。

q16.explanationZh: clerk“职员，办事员”，a bank clerk“银行职员”。

q18.explanationZh: click 名词“咔哒声”，动词“（用鼠标）点击”。

q19.explanationZh: client“委托人；客户”，指接受专业服务的人。

q21.explanationZh: climate“气候”，指长期的气候；weather 指某时的天气。

q22.explanationZh: climb“攀登”，可作动词和名词，词尾 b 不发音。

q24.explanationZh: clock 指挂钟、座钟；手表是 watch。

q25.explanationZh: clone 名词“克隆（体）”，动词“克隆”。

q26.explanationZh: close 作动词“关闭”读 /kləʊz/，作形容词、副词“接近的；紧密的”读 /kləʊs/。

q27.explanationZh: cloth“布；织物”，作“衣料”讲时不可数。

q29.explanationZh: clothing 是集合名词，指衣服的总称，不可数。

q30.explanationZh: cloud 名词“云”，动词“使模糊；变暗”。

q31.explanationZh: cloud 加 -y 变成形容词 cloudy“多云的”。

q32.explanationZh: club“俱乐部”，join a club“加入俱乐部”。

q35.explanationZh: clear sth. of sth.“清除某处的某物”，clear the streets of snow“清除街上的积雪”。

q37.explanationZh: classic 作形容词“第一流的”，a classic horse race“一场一流的赛马”。

accept: the click of a door latch

q38.explanationZh: click 作名词“咔哒声”，the click of a door latch“开门锁的咔哒声”。

q39.explanationZh: close at hand“在旁边，在眼前”。

q40.explanationZh: close to“离……近”，这里 close 读 /kləʊs/。

q41.explanationZh: cloth 作“布”讲不可数，用 yard 等量词计量：three yards of cloth。

q42.explanationZh: clothing 不可数，“一件衣服”用 an article of clothing（也说 a piece of clothing）。

q43.explanationZh: cloth 与不定冠词连用指有特殊用途的布：a table cloth“桌布”。

q44.explanationZh: clothes 只用复数，a baby in long clothes“襁褓中的婴孩”。

q45.explanationZh: make it clear that ...“明确表示……”，it 是形式宾语，that 从句是真正的宾语。

q46.explanationZh: close 作形容词“密切的”，pay close attention to“密切关注”。

q47.explanationZh: a clue to ...“……的线索”，get a clue to“得到……的线索”。

q48.explanationZh: and 连接两个祈使句动词，用原形 clean“把……弄干净”。

q49.explanationZh: class 作动词“把……归为”，叙述过去的判断用过去式 classed。

q50.explanationZh: “一块布”是 a piece of cloth，cloth 作“衣料”讲不可数。

q51.explanationZh: Each 后接可数名词单数，clone“克隆体”与母体遗传信息相同。

q52.explanationZh: 公路“被关闭”，be 后用过去分词 closed。

q53.explanationZh: climb up to the top“爬到山顶”，与 were 一致用过去式 climbed。

q54.explanationZh: need doing 表示被动意义“需要被……”，所以用 cleaning（= needs to be cleaned）。

q55.explanationZh: had 后接过去分词构成过去完成时，claimed“声称”。

q56.explanationZh: clap sb. on the back“拍某人的背”，过去式 clapped 双写 p。

q57.explanationZh: 主语 Men 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形 classify“把……分类”。

q58.explanationZh: classical“古典的”，修饰名词 selections，指古典音乐选段。

q59.sampleAnswer: The present era makes great claims upon us.
references: The present era makes great claims upon us.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “对……提出要求”= make claims on/upon ...；claim 在这里是名词“要求”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Whether they are musical pieces or paintings, classic works all have a power that goes beyond time and space.
references: Whether they are musical pieces or paintings, classic works all have a power that goes beyond time and space.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “无论……还是……”= whether ... or ...；“经典作品”= classic works；“跨越时空”= go beyond time and space。

q61.sampleAnswer: The Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest in the world.
references: The Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest in the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “……之一”= one of + 最高级 + 复数名词；civilisation / civilization 两种拼写都可以。

q62.sampleAnswer: The students held a party in honor of their class teacher.
references: The students held a party in honor of their class teacher.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “班主任”= class teacher；“以表敬意”= in honor of ...；“举行晚会”= hold a party。

q63.sampleAnswer: We should pay close attention to the safety of students.
references: We should pay close attention to the safety of students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “密切关注”= pay close attention to，close 作形容词“密切的”。

q64.sampleAnswer: The sky is overcast now, but I think it will clear up soon.
references: The sky is overcast now, but I think it will clear up soon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “转晴”= clear up，表示天气放晴时不用被动；“阴沉的”= overcast。

q65.sampleAnswer: You’d better go to the clinic and have a thorough check.
references: You’d better go to the clinic and have a thorough check.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “最好做某事”= had better do；“诊所”= clinic；“做彻底检查”= have a thorough check。

q66.sampleAnswer: In recent years, some scientists and organizations have made public their intentions to clone human beings.
references: In recent years, some scientists and organizations have made public their intentions to clone human beings.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “近年来”用现在完成时；“公开宣布”= make public，宾语较长时放在 public 后；“克隆人”= clone human beings。

q67.sampleAnswer: The neighbor has made it clear that if you play rock music deep into the night, he will complain to the police about it.
references: The neighbor has made it clear that if you play rock music deep into the night, he will complain to the police about it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “明确表示”= make it clear that ...；“向警方投诉”= complain to the police about ...。

q68.sampleAnswer: It’s not easy to make the river clean again, but our government has recently launched a drive to get rid of the river pollution completely.
references: It’s not easy to make the river clean again, but our government has recently launched a drive to get rid of the river pollution completely.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “使河流变清”= make the river clean，clean 作宾语补足语；“发起运动”= launch a drive；“清除”= get rid of。
